versions.changelog:
Initial release of cn-uuid-generator.

- Generates UUIDs in multiple formats: v1 (timestamp), v4 (random), v5 (namespace-based), and short UUIDs (Base62).
- Supports batch UUID generation and local processing without API calls.
- Compatible with Python 3.6+ and uses no external dependencies.
- Includes natural language command support in Chinese for generating UUIDs.
